sources.title: Vertex AI: Building a fraud detection model with AutoML
sources.snippet: In this lab we'll be build a fraud detection model to determine whether or not a particular credit card transaction should be classified as fraudulent. One challenge of many fraud detection and anomaly detection problems is that the dataset is typically heavily imbalanced, with many more examples of the non-fraudulent class.

Built for precision and scalability, the system evaluates transactional patterns and flags potential fraud in real time — with a focus on performance, security, and interpretability.
